title: Concentration of the biased sign average
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $p\in[0,1]$, and let $t\ge0$. Choose $n$ independent signs $X_1,\ldots,X_n\in\{-1,1\}$, each equal to $1$ with probability $1-p$ and to $-1$ with probability $p$, and write $A_n=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n X_i$. Then $\Pr(|A_n-(1-2p)|\ge t)\le 2\exp(-nt^2/2)$.
